verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an operating system, but the evidence pack never documents a way for users to set up automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled tasks or background agents. The PowerShell CLI probe only shows a scripting shell exists, not recurring or background execution. The 'automated updates' mention is about OS servicing, not user-defined automations, so both count as adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
